Reviewed Community Pack 18aug2026p2. The delta changes only the four embedded Marauder images for S2, WROOM/DevBoard Pro, C5 DevKitC-1, and S3 MultiBoard; ESP Flasher FAP C code and application.fam are unchanged. Tumoflip retains the exact ESP Flasher target bytes from FW Packages Stable003. Board firmware is delivered through a separate manual channel and is not accepted into the FW Packages FAP.

Tumoflip keeps its accepted profile editor and Module One route.
